entities.summary: Rebecca Michelle Sherrill is an American politician, former naval officer, and former federal prosecutor serving since 2026 as the 57th governor of New Jersey. She is a member of the Democratic Party. Mikie Sherrill was a naval commanders from Alexandria (b. 1972-01-19, Alexandria). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
